title: Libraesva Services
description: [E507 Studio](https://e507.it/) commissioned me to create a video for Libraesva, a company that focuses on email security services. The video illustrates the four main services provided by the company in a fun and engaging way.

title: Football Society Intro
description:
[E507 Studio](https://e507.it/) commissioned me to create an intro for Football Society, a podcast dedicated to a romantic vision of football, including passion, anecdotes, and football culture. The style had to stand out from typical football shows and reflect the podcast’s unique character.
I worked on bringing the client’s core idea to life (a mug being hit by a football) as well as adding sound effects and selecting the music.

title: Growermetal Open Day
description:
[E507 Studio](https://e507.it/) commissioned me to create a short video for Growermetal, a major company producing washers. The video was made for an Open Day, when the workers’ families were invited to visit the factory. It’s a fun and easy explanation of what Growermetal does and how washers are made.
I took care of the illustrations and animations, while the client provided the script.

title: Billy Bruco
description:
During my university internship at [Watermelon](https://watermelon.it/), I created a series of three animated video loops as a playful symbol of our collaboration. Designed for Instagram, the project features Billy Bruco, a cheerful little caterpillar with a big appetite.
I developed the concept, illustrations, motion design, and sound design independently, with valuable feedback and support from the studio.

title: (Against) The Noise Machine
description:
A conceptual design project exploring the cultural suppression of silence through a speculative dystopia.
(Against) The Noise Machine blends video, editorial design, web and audio to question the normalization of constant noise.

blocks.title: (Against) The Noise Machine
blocks.content:
Silence is being systematically reduced by contemporary communication systems. Constant output is rewarded, filling every gap with signals that compete for attention. Without pauses, reflection becomes harder.

This thesis treats silence as a functional element rather than an absence. It examines how saturation affects perception, cognition, and visual communication, focusing on how continuous exposure reshapes the way information is processed.

The research combines theory and design practice. Using visual design to test how silence and noise can structure meaning.

The project develops a dystopia called The Noise Machine, a world where silence is illegal. This scenario makes the effects of saturation visible, showing what happens when no space is left for interruption or distance.

title: Flor.es
description:
Visual identity and UI/UX design for Flor.es, an app that allows users to remotely monitor and control indoor cultivation systems of any scale.
Developed a complete design system, including a custom icon set and a friendly mascot named Florenzio, who guides users through the app with helpful tips and a touch of personality.

title: Apatia
description:
This video was part of a group project structured around four emotional states: euphoria, anger, despair, and apathy.
I was in charge of the final segment, "Apatia", which served as the closing chapter. Through a slow, dreamlike pace and abstract sound, I aimed to convey a sense of emotional numbness and detachment. I pictured a character who is physically present but mentally adrift.

title: Momo
description:
An illustrated book adaptation of Momo by Michael Ende. Aimed at children and young readers, the book explores the concept of time through the story of a girl who listens deeply and helps others reclaim their stolen moments from the mysterious "Grey Men."
The visual approach reflects the story’s dual nature, both playful and profound, combining imperfect, childlike forms with more detailed focal elements. Text and illustration are tightly integrated across the layout, with dynamic interactions and occasional double-page spreads designed to enhance immersion and emotional resonance.

title: Meomao
description: An interactive xPub for children that blends storytelling with simple gameplay mechanics. The narrative follows Meomao, a black cat on a quest to save the citizens of Catoland from a strange illness by finding the legendary magic tuna. The experience unfolds in a minimalist black-and-white world, where through interactive choices and light puzzle elements, children engage with the story in an intuitive and playful way.

title: Creativity
description: A short video featuring a talking character. I was given complete creative freedom in choosing the style, and I decided to use John Cleese’s speech on creativity as the basis for my project.

blocks.content: The mouth, eyes and hands in this video are animated using the Mouthiverse script.

title: Quinoa Promo
description:
[E507 Studio](https://e507.it/) commissioned me to create the presentation video for Quinoa, an AI chatbot tool developed by Sesamo Srl.
The client provided the base audio and a general storyline.

title: Scenario Festival
description: [E507 Studio](https://e507.it/) commissioned me to create six videos for Scenario Festival, a music festival in Lecco, to promote the event on socials.

title: WeRead Promo
description:
Visual identity of a reading app called "WeRead" and a 30-second promotional video for it.
I was given complete creative freedom.

title: Mentalisti
description:
[E507 Studio](https://e507.it/) commissioned me to create motion videos for the second and third episodes of ‘Mentalisti,’ an event series hosted by the studio.
Each video highlights a distinct element inspired by the evening’s featured artist, with the studio providing the base promotional poster design and general graphic style.
